description: Run a comprehensive website health audit — SSL, DNS, DMARC/SPF/DKIM, page performance, uptime, and broken links. Returns a 0-100 health score with letter grade, critical issues, warnings, and actionable recommendations. All checks run in parallel for speed.

checkLinks.description: Include broken link check (adds ~10-20s). Default: true

maxLinks.description: Max links to check for broken links. Default: 50

url.description: Website URL or domain to audit (e.g. 'https://example.com' or 'example.com')

name: audit_site
title: Full Site Health Audit
